title: Identify patients diagnosed with SJS who have at least one of the following
question: Identify patients diagnosed with SJS who have at least one of the following: abnormal white blood cell count or high total cholesterol. For each such patient, return their ID, sex, age at first hospital visit, and the number of distinct laboratory test dates they have. Only include patients with valid birthday and first hospital visit dates. Order the results by age at first visit in ascending order.

prediction.sql: SELECT P."XCL_058" AS ID, P."XCL_059" AS Sex, STRFTIME('%Y', P."XCL_062") - STRFTIME('%Y', P."XCL_060") AS AgeAtFirstVisit, COUNT(DISTINCT L."XCL_015") AS DistinctLabDates FROM Patient AS P INNER JOIN Laboratory AS L ON P."XCL_058" = L."XCL_014" WHERE P."XCL_064" = 'SJS' AND NOT P."XCL_060" IS NULL AND NOT P."XCL_062" IS NULL AND P."XCL_058" IN (SELECT L2."XCL_014" FROM Laboratory AS L2 WHERE (L2."XCL_030" <= 3.5 OR L2."XCL_030" >= 9.0) OR L2."XCL_026" > 250) GROUP BY P."XCL_058", P."XCL_059", STRFTIME('%Y', P."XCL_062") - STRFTIME('%Y', P."XCL_060") ORDER BY AgeAtFirstVisit ASC

arguments.sql:
SELECT
    P."XCL_058" AS ID,
    P."XCL_059" AS Sex,
    STRFTIME('%Y', P."XCL_062") - STRFTIME('%Y', P."XCL_060") AS AgeAtFirstVisit,
    COUNT(DISTINCT L."XCL_015") AS DistinctLabDates
FROM
    Patient P
INNER JOIN
    Laboratory L ON P."XCL_058" = L."XCL_014"
WHERE
    P."XCL_064" = 'SJS'
    AND P."XCL_060" IS NOT NULL
    AND P."XCL_062" IS NOT NULL
    AND EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM Laboratory L2
        WHERE L2."XCL_014" = P."XCL_058"
          AND (
              (L2."XCL_030" < 3.5 OR L2."XCL_030" > 9.0)
              OR L2."XCL_026" > 250
          )
    )
GROUP BY
    P."XCL_058",
    P."XCL_059",
    STRFTIME('%Y', P."XCL_062") - STRFTIME('%Y', P."XCL_060")
ORDER BY
    AgeAtFirstVisit ASC

SELECT
    P."XCL_058" AS ID,
    P."XCL_059" AS Sex,
    STRFTIME('%Y', P."XCL_062") - STRFTIME('%Y', P."XCL_060") AS AgeAtFirstVisit,
    COUNT(DISTINCT L."XCL_015") AS DistinctLabDates
FROM
    Patient P
INNER JOIN
    Laboratory L ON P."XCL_058" = L."XCL_014"
WHERE
    P."XCL_064" = 'SJS'
    AND P."XCL_060" IS NOT NULL
    AND P."XCL_062" IS NOT NULL
    AND EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM Laboratory L2
        WHERE L2."XCL_014" = P."XCL_058"
          AND (
              (L2."XCL_030" <= 3.5 OR L2."XCL_030" >= 9.0)
              OR L2."XCL_026" > 250
          )
    )
GROUP BY
    P."XCL_058",
    P."XCL_059",
    STRFTIME('%Y', P."XCL_062") - STRFTIME('%Y', P."XCL_060")
ORDER BY
    AgeAtFirstVisit ASC
